name: Tidewater 5: Send Email
description: Call to CRM (project 8): sends an email with Gmail in live mode or writes it to the Tidewater Outbox table in test mode.

parameters.content:
## Tidewater 5: Send Email
Every email (follow-ups to prospects, notices to the rep) goes through here. With `mode = live` in **Tidewater Settings** it sends with Gmail; in test mode it writes to the **Tidewater Outbox** table instead, so nothing reaches a real prospect while testing.
